自主运行的混合控制演示。视场编码、脉冲读出与飞行控制是人工设定；全量连接组计算真: A hybrid control experiment. Sensory encoding, spike readout and flight control are engineered; the full connectome computes model spikes. This is not a brain that has learned to fly, or a complete biophysical simulation. Both views share the same model clock.
“逼近”“甜味”“机械”“光”是直接刺激对应注释类型的实验入口，尚未由自然刺激编: Looming, taste, mechanics and light directly stimulate annotated cell types. These inputs are not calibrated against natural sensory encoding or experimental recordings. The resting network has no background noise; silence without input is a model result. R1–R6 fast transmitter effects are not modeled, so the light entry shows direct responses and does not reproduce full visual propagation.
快速突触符号假设：乙酰胆碱兴奋；GABA 和谷氨酸抑制。受体特异性作用、神经调质: Fast synaptic sign assumptions: acetylcholine is excitatory; GABA and glutamate are inhibitory. Receptor-specific effects, neuromodulation, missing electrical synapses, dendritic/axonal compartments, ion channels and body feedback are not modeled. Other or unknown fast transmitter effects are set to zero; structural connections remain intact. This does not establish real perception, behavior or full biophysical fidelity.

快速突触符号假设：乙酰胆碱兴奋；GABA 和谷氨酸抑制。受体特异性作用、神经调质: Fast synaptic sign assumptions: acetylcholine is excitatory; GABA and glutamate are inhibitory. Receptor-specific effects, neuromodulation, missing electrical synapses, dendritic/axonal compartments, ion channels and real body dynamics are not modeled. Other or unknown fast transmitter effects are set to zero; structural connections remain intact. This does not establish real perception, behavior or full biophysical fidelity.
所有点均来自原始 somaLocation，单位为 8 nm 体素。缺少胞体坐标: Every plotted point comes from the original somaLocation in 8 nm voxels. Neurons missing soma coordinates participate in computation but are not plotted. All three axes are converted to micrometers with uniform scale, centering and rigid rotation only. Distances are preserved. Points show somas, not dendrites or axons; overlap does not imply connectivity. Missing coordinates are never filled in randomly.
这是全量连接组上的点神经元 LIF 模型。每个纳入的神经元都有膜电位、突触电流和: This is a point-neuron LIF model on the full retained connectome. Each neuron has a membrane potential, synaptic current and refractory period. Computation uses 0.2 ms steps and a 1.8 ms transmission delay in a separate worker. Brightness encodes time since each computed spike. The afterglow only slows visual decay; it creates no additional spike events.

参数参考 Shiu 等的果蝇全脑 LIF 模型：静息/复位电位 −52 mV、阈: Parameters are informed by the whole-brain LIF model of Shiu et al.: rest/reset −52 mV, threshold −45 mV, membrane time constant 20 ms, synaptic time constant 5 ms, refractory period 2.2 ms and weight per synaptic contact 0.275 mV. These were not measured separately for every MaleCNS neuron. Selected cell types receive Poisson inputs with refractory periods preserved.
嗅觉 / 听觉读数来自实际计算出的群体平均脉冲率，按细胞数加权、110 ms 平: Olfactory and auditory readouts use computed population firing rates, weighted by cell count and smoothed over 110 ms. Residual activity and smoothing can persist briefly after an input is turned off. Editing sources preserves voltages, time and spike history. These input neurons lack original soma coordinates: they appear in computation and rasters, not as invented 3D points. Each downstream probe is the positioned direct target with greatest summed input synapse weight. It is an anatomical sample, not necessarily the most active cell or the full pathway.
食物气味人工编码到 148 个有左右侧注释的 ORN_DM1 / ORN_VA2: Food odor is artificially encoded into 148 lateralized ORN_DM1 / ORN_VA2 cells, illustrating two food-attraction-related olfactory channels, not a complete fruit odor profile. A smooth distance field omits airflow, obstacle effects on diffusion, concentration units and hunger. Food guidance gates a local-gradient follower with actual ORN spikes. It is an engineered assist, not a validated olfactory-to-motor circuit, and does not simulate landing or eating. Turning guidance off preserves olfactory input.
72 个视场通过射线读取环境亮度，人工分配给 3,377 个 R1–R6 光感受: 72 ray-cast visual fields are artificially assigned to 3,377 R1–R6 photoreceptors. Source left/right labels are preserved, but virtual field assignments are not measured retinotopy. Phototaxis is read from computed receptor spikes. 311 LC4/LPLC2 cells receive local-proximity input and activate downstream neurons through the connectome. Because R1–R6 fast transmitter effects are not modeled, steering reads receptors directly, without a validated intermediate visual pathway or muscle control from motor neurons.
声源人工编码到 101 个有左右侧注释、编号明确的 JO-A / JO-B 细胞: Sound is artificially encoded into 101 lateralized, numbered JO-A / JO-B cells, excluding unclear types and other auditory populations. The encoder approximates distance, amplitude, frequency tuning and an amplitude envelope. A/B curves are illustrative, not measured per-cell tuning. The intermittent pattern is 350 ms per second, not actual courtship song. Pressure, reflections, carrier phase and physical acoustics are omitted; amplitude percentages are not decibels. Sound changes network computation but has no assumed approach or escape behavior. Food and speaker geometry are enlarged source markers, not collision bodies.
纳入全部 ${fmt(manifest.neurons)} 个已分类神经元；${: All ${fmt(manifest.neurons)} classified neurons are included; ${fmt(manifest.neurons-manifest.soma_positions)} missing soma positions still participate. Another ${fmt(manifest.excluded_unclassified)} unclassified or unconfirmed segments are excluded as neurons. Fast transmitter effects are set to zero for ${fmt(manifest.unresolved_fast_sign_neurons)} neurons with unresolved fast synaptic signs.
转向读出、距离避障、速度与高度稳定均为工程模型。室内灯使用方向响应、距离衰减和遮: Steering readout, avoidance, speed and altitude stabilization are engineered. The lamp approximates directional response, falloff and occlusion. Moving the occluder changes brightness and local distances. Flashes last 350 ms of model time. These encoders are not measured receptive fields. Start positions apply to the next release; editing lights and obstacles preserves neural state. The environment updates every 20 ms of model time, with no preset route or exit coordinates supplied to the controller. Collisions use solid furniture bounding boxes and a spherical fly; the region below the table is also blocked. Closed windows transmit light but block passage. Green bars beneath the visual fields show receptor firing rates. Once the fly escapes, both views pause at the same model time.
